why: Issue #597. A slot already bound to a pad Tanks cannot read shows that pad as its current source with no 'not supported' suffix, which is exactly how a working pad reads. The pad is present, so the disconnected suffix does not fire either. Killed by the assigned-unsupported-pad case.
killedBy: hud: controller assignment panel (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-17-controller-assignment.md) a pad the browser reports but Tanks cannot read (issue #597) marks a slot whose ASSIGNED pad cannot be read, rather than showing it as working
